evidence.detail: rs/l/D is constructed only by R421 RSImageProducer on the first successful BufferedImage draw and is submitted with SwingUtilities.invokeLater.

run() sizes the Launcher JFrame to 1134x537 or 1312x800 depending on the client mode flag, centers it on the screen, ensures visibility where required, and maximizes when the configured layout exceeds the display width.
The Runnable owns no rendering state beyond its synthetic RSImageProducer parent reference and performs only one-shot Launcher JFrame layout/visibility work.
